items.answer: 3x and 2y are unlike terms (different letters), so they cannot be collected into a single term.

items.stem: Explain the difference between an expression, an equation and a formula.
items.answer: An expression is a collection of terms with no equals sign; an equation has an equals sign and can be solved for an unknown; a formula is a rule linking two or more variables.
items.markingKey: B1 expression no equals sign; B1 equation/formula distinguished [2]

items.answer: 3x² = 3 × 4 = 12 (only x is squared), but (3x)² = 6² = 36 (the whole of 3x is squared).

items.stem: Explain why it is useful to put a substituted negative number in brackets.

items.answer: (x + 5)² = (x + 5)(x + 5) = x² + 5x + 5x + 25 = x² + 10x + 25; the two middle terms 10x are missing from x² + 25.
